scope: Web pages are much faster, websites like YouTube are easier to control, every screen has an Alt menu, and Chrome and Thunderbird are easier to set up.

topics.title: App mode for websites
details: Press Insert+Space to switch between app mode and browse mode. You can also say App mode or Browse mode.
In app mode, keys go straight to the website. For example, on YouTube, K pauses, J and L skip, and M mutes.
If NVDA or JAWS is running, press Control+Alt+Space instead. Screen readers keep Insert+Space for themselves.
Each website remembers its mode.

topics.title: Sliders
details: Sliders like the YouTube seek bar and volume are read with their value, such as Seek slider, 1:23 of 4:05.
Press Enter on a slider, or Tab to it. Then use the arrow keys to move it. You hear the new value.
Press Escape to go back to browse mode.

topics.title: Alt menu on every screen
details: Press Alt on any screen to open its menu. Press Alt again to close it.
The email menu has what you need for mail. It has folders, drafts and contacts. It also has Add account.
The word processor menu has not changed.

topics.title: Set up Chrome
details: Say Set up Chrome. Companion installs Chrome if it is missing. Then it adds the Voice Companion extension from the Chrome Web Store.
Chrome asks you to turn the extension on. Companion reads the Chrome buttons for you. Press Tab until you hear Enable extension, then press Enter.
Companion tells you when Chrome is linked.

topics.title: Faster web pages
details: Busy pages like YouTube are much faster. Reading a page used to take seconds. Now it takes less than one second.
The app no longer freezes on pages that keep changing.
When a YouTube ad can be skipped, you hear Skip ad button ready. Say Skip ad to press it.

topics.title: Web pages
details: In a search box that suggests words, you now hear New suggestions available when the list changes.
Say Close browser window, or press Control+Shift+W, to close the browser. This works even when Keep browser window open is on.

topics.title: Thunderbird
details: When you choose Thunderbird, Companion checks what is missing and tells you the next step.
It can install its connection in Thunderbird for you, and it can start Thunderbird. Say yes or no.
Thunderbird must be installed first. Its website is thunderbird dot net.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
